title: One AI Conversation Can Drink 500 Milliliters
hook: One AI conversation can consume 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Every AI request has physical infrastructure, and local water supplies absorb its hidden cost.
question: Should AI companies disclose water use?

segments.say: Microsoft reached 6.4 million cubic meters of water. AI infrastructure turned computing growth into a physical resource demand.
Google used 21.2 million cubic meters. The AI race is also a race for water.
One AI conversation can use 500 milliliters. Millions of chats turn a bottle-sized cost into real pressure.
